meta.workstream: ws_runtime (automatic completion, persistence, payout, event support)
meta.evidence_class: CODE_VERIFIED unless a test is cited; no tests or Godot run in this audit

evidence: src/stream/server_items.gd:15679-15688 _goal_made increments goal_counts['made:<item id>'] by 1 and runs _goals_check
src/stream/server_items.gd:17414 the ONLY call of _goal_made: in _craft_tick after a queued craft finishes (hand, station, station-store output, chop recipe, sealed batch)
src/stream/server_items.gd:17396-17401 a sealed (ready_age) recipe makes the whole queued batch in one completion: one _goal_made call for N crafts
src/stream/server_items.gd:17408-17411 chop recipe output is _chop_yield (12 firewood per log) but still one _goal_made call

src/stream/server_items.gd:1218-1219 + src/shared/recipe_table.gd:118-136 legacy ACT_CRAFT immediate craft: no _goal_made (client sends it only from test harnesses: src/client/held_item.gd:3286,3301, src/client/inventory_view.gd:5269-5270)
src/stream/server_items.gd:9170-9203 chopping-block hand split (E): wooden block -> firewood dropped beside the block, no _goal_made
src/stream/server_items.gd:9223-9278 _chop_loose_log: axe on a loose log -> 3 wooden blocks dropped in the world, no _goal_made
src/stream/server_items.gd:9421-9449 _kiln_burn: charcoal into the kiln output, no _goal_made
src/stream/server_items.gd:9834-9864 _tend_fire: raw food in a lit fire's store becomes cooking.json cooks_into/gives (roast_*), no _goal_made
src/stream/server_items.gd:7650-7668 _cook (ACT_COOK): roast into the pack, no _goal_made
src/stream/server_trade.gd:336-338 purchase gives items via items.give with _gain_source 'trade' (not a craft; does not count for made_item; does count for have_item checks)
caveats: Counts are per completed craft ACTION, not per unit produced (twine x2 recipe sinew_cord counts 1; jerky recipe gives 2 per craft; a sealed batch of N counts 1; a chop of 1 log giving 12 firewood counts 1).
Credit is by output item id (recipe['gives'][0]), so every recipe that yields the item counts (twine from fibre, bark or sinew); variants (Tempered/+1) count as the same item.
Only connected peers' queues tick (src/stream/server_items.gd:17292); credit lands when the craft finishes, never at queue time; a cancelled entry gives no credit.
Admin free-craft entries (free_entry) also call _goal_made (src/stream/server_items.gd:17306-17316, src/stream/server_items.gd:17414).

Craft goals whose main-route instruction uses a non-queue path will never complete: craft:firewood (draft line 46 instructs the hand split), craft:wooden_block(_soft) via hand chop, craft:charcoal via kiln, craft:roast_forage via fire store.

evidence: src/stream/server_items.gd:8365-8477 _place_structure: every kit or blueprint piece (doors snapped into doorways src/stream/server_items.gd:3733-3740, roof panels, stations, add-ons attached to fire/fireplace/table, traps, handcart) ends here
src/stream/server_items.gd:8470-8472 a blueprint SITE does not count when put down; src/stream/server_items.gd:8948-8956 _finish_site calls _after_built for the peer who deposits the last material
src/stream/server_items.gd:3790-3829 campfire_kit is placed by its own branch and fires _goal_event(peer,'placed','campfire')
src/stream/server_items.gd:7901-7955 _place_torch (hand_placed standing_torch, torch_sconce): no goal event
src/stream/server_items.gd:14628 tilled_bed created by hoeing: no placed event
src/stream/server_items.gd:9136-9145 opening/closing a door changes struct kind (toggle) without an event: no re-count, and no '<door>_open' credit
caveats: No upgrade system exists (no 'upgrade' in server_items.gd): station levels are separate structures, each counted by its own kind.

Take-down (src/stream/server_items.gd:9038) / pick-up of a fire (src/stream/server_items.gd:4582-4610) and placing again counts again; goals pay once so there is no money farm, but any build goal with count > 1 could be met by moving one piece.
free_build (admin) placements fire the event too (src/stream/server_items.gd:8435-8436).

All 256 draft build keys are structures.json kinds that place through _place_structure (checked against structures.json: none is hand_placed, path_patch or tilled_bed); 24 are BLUEPRINT_LOCKED/NOT_KNOWN statically (pass1 flags) and cannot be placed today, a buildability matter for another workstream.

evidence: No _goal_event/_goal_made call in any acquisition path: gather() src/stream/server_items.gd:1563, _gather_berries src/stream/server_items.gd:1761, _process_carcass src/stream/server_items.gd:2288, _give_dig_yield src/stream/server_items.gd:3369, _dig_bog_iron src/stream/server_items.gd:3405, _hit_boulder src/stream/server_items.gd:5568, _mine src/stream/server_items.gd:3560, _pickup src/stream/server_items.gd:4619, _pickup_batch src/stream/server_items.gd:4706, _process_trunk src/stream/server_items.gd:6423, _hit_shrub src/stream/server_items.gd:7117, gather_edge src/stream/server_items.gd:13954, take_nest src/stream/server_items.gd:14042, harvest src/stream/server_items.gd:14757

src/stream/server_items.gd:4884-4891 + src/stream/server_items.gd:4929-4947 every pack gain passes _send_changes -> _report_gains, which only notifies the client feed (send_received) with a source tag (pickup/harvest/craft/quest/trade)
src/stream/server_items.gd:10042-10066 _box_take adds to the pack under the default 'pickup' source: a central gain hook would count chest withdrawals unless a container source tag is added

Only existing alternative: {have_item, count} momentary inventory poll (src/stream/server_items.gd:15723-15724) which loses credit once the item is used, and is also satisfied by purchase, admin give or chest withdrawal
caveats: Draft section 3 (docs/design/PLAYER_GOALS_REWARDS_DRAFT.md:768): completion checks must use verified world state, never merely an inventory item.
Whether bought/traded/looted/chest items should count is a creator decision (not decided anywhere I found).
Fire tier changes happen at about ten sites, several with no acting peer; see goals.activity:medium_fire.

existing.support: 26 of 28 complete through the current engine as data is written (jerky, salted_fish, story, night_walk included despite needs_code:true); 2 (twine, fell) pay ITEMS not coins
caveats: `after` gating defers every goal until its prerequisites are done (src/stream/server_items.gd:15740-15747, src/stream/server_items.gd:15763).

drink.completion_condition: goal_counts['event:drink'] >= 1; fired by ACT_DRINK when the player's 'wet' vital rose (any drink action through _drink_water, water at the feet or the slot passed).
evidence: src/worldgen/tools/test_goals.gd:84-90 (AUTOMATED_TESTED: drink completes and pays 2 copper; not run in this audit)
drink.notes: after: [] (open at start). Matches draft text. A drink that does not raise 'wet' (full) does not count.

fibre.completion_condition: inv.count_of(plant_fibre) >= 12 at the moment of a check (momentary possession, every slow tick and after every goal event).
evidence: test_goals.gd:93-95 (admin give of 40 fibre completes it)
fibre.notes: Works as text describes ONLY if 12 are held at once. A player who twists twine as fibre comes in may never hold 12; every other starter goal except drink depends on fibre through `after` (twine, sell -> axe -> fell -> hammer/fire -> ...), so the whole chain is deferred. Also satisfied by buying fibre from Hob (data/npcs/shops.json hob.stock includes plant_fibre), admin give or chest withdrawal. Draft line 773 asks to preserve historical acquisition counts. Recommend a cumulative 'got:plant_fibre' counter (NEW event, see gather) and no `after`.

twine.completion_condition: goal_counts['made:twine'] >= 2 (two completed twine crafts of any recipe giving twine: twine, twine_bark, sinew_cord); after: [fibre].
evidence: test_goals.gd:96-98 asserts 2 crafts complete it and give 4 sticks
twine.notes: MISMATCH: data reward is {item: [stick, 4]}; draft line 32 pays 4 copper; creator requires money-only rewards. Count is per craft action, so sinew_cord (gives 2) needs two crafts. Draft text 'make 2' matches only for the 1-unit recipes. Changing the reward does not re-pay characters who already have 'twine' in goals_done.

axe.completion_condition: max(goal_counts['made:stone_axe'], inv.count_of(stone_axe)) >= 1 (or_have: crafted ever, or one held now); after: [twine].
axe.notes: Draft says 'craft a Stone - Axe'; the data also pays for a bought/given axe (Dino round 6 decision quoted in code comment src/stream/server_items.gd:15718). A purchase path for a 'make' goal is a design inconsistency with craft:* goals, which do not accept purchases.

fell.completion_condition: goal_counts['event:tree_felled'] >= 1; fired when the last axe blow fells a standing tree; after: [axe].
fell.notes: MISMATCH: data reward is {item: [kindling, 3]}; draft line 36 pays 6 copper (money-only required). A tree brought down by digging under it (src/stream/server_items.gd:3311-3346 -> _fell) fires no event.

hammer.completion_condition: inv count of any of [wooden_hammer, wooden_hammer_soft, stone_hammer] >= 1 at the moment of a check; after: [fell].
evidence: data/items/recipes.json recipes.wooden_hammer and recipes.wooden_hammer_soft both give wooden_hammer
hammer.notes: Draft (line 39, and line 776) says 'craft a Wooden - Hammer'. Check is possession, not crafting; 'wooden_hammer_soft' is a recipe id, not an item, so that entry is dead; stone_hammer also pays this goal AND the separate craft:stone_hammer (4 copper) -> one advanced tool pays two milestones (draft line 776 asks to clarify). A hammer that broke/was sold before 'fell' completed is not credited. Recommend made:wooden_hammer >= 1.

fire.completion_condition: goal_counts['event:fire_lit'] >= 1; fired by ACT_LIGHT when the fire was laid (state 9) or warm ash and is lit after _light; after: [fell].
evidence: src/client/inventory_view.gd:855-860 (E on a laid/ash fire sends ACT_LIGHT)
fire.notes: Draft line 42 is correct about controls (F opens the fire store: src/client/key_bindings.gd:29; E lights). No starter is needed (src/stream/server_items.gd:7565-7566); a placed campfire already holds start sticks (src/stream/server_items.gd:3822-3827), so adding sticks is optional. Not counted: fire arrow ignition (src/stream/server_items.gd:2446-2465), coals catching new wood (src/stream/server_items.gd:4538-4548). Any player lighting any fire counts; relighting after putting it out counts again (harmless). Old hint text 'Put sticks on it with F' predates the store: ACT_FUEL exists on the server (src/stream/server_items.gd:1128-1129) but no client code sends it (only tests).

hoe.completion_condition: inv count of any of [wooden_hoe, stone_hoe, steel_hoe] >= 1 at the moment of a check; after: [fire].
hoe.notes: Draft line 278 says craft a Wooden - Hoe. stone_hoe and steel_hoe also pay this goal AND craft:stone_hoe (5) / craft:steel_hoe (20); iron_hoe is not in the list (inconsistent). Possession-based: a hoe broken/sold before 'fire' completes is lost. Recommend made:wooden_hoe >= 1.

path.completion_condition: goal_counts['event:path_laid'] >= 15 (one per path patch laid by hoe stroke or by the survey road builder); after: [hoe].
path.notes: 'from camp to the water' is not checked: any 15 patches anywhere count. Each patch event runs a full _goals_check scan (performance).

berries.notes: Draft says 'edible wild plant or berry'; any food that feeds counts (bought roast_forage, cooked meat).

bed.notes: Draft 'place it under cover' is not checked; any rough_bed placement counts. Other bed kinds do not count.

workbench.notes: Placing a Carpenter's bench (log_workbench) pays this goal (10) AND build:log_workbench (40): one placement, two milestones. Draft line 54 names the Wooden - Workbench only.

winter_store.completion_condition: count held at once of smoked_fish + jerky + dried_berries + salted_fish + trail_bread >= 5; after: [smoke_fish, dry_berries].
winter_store.notes: Momentary possession, as the draft text says ('Hold 5'); eaten food is lost credit; Maturing/age is not considered; satisfied by chest withdrawal. Conflicts with draft line 768 ('never merely an inventory item') if that rule is approved.

fur_for_winter.completion_condition: _worn_warmth(peer) >= 0.7 (layered warmth of worn pieces, capped 0.85), checked every slow tick; after: [knife].
fur_for_winter.notes: Hood+cloak+boots = 0.55 (test) does not complete; a full hide set (head 0.1, body 0.3, feet 0.15, hands 0.08-0.1, legs 0.12-0.18 per items.json warmth) reaches ~0.75-0.83 before layering rules, so 'full hide set' is plausible; exact layered total not computed here. 'before winter' not checked.

story.completion_condition: goal_counts['hit:story'] >= 1, incremented by note_talked when a dialogue with npc 'edda' OPENS while the game hour is in [19, 23); after: [fire].
evidence: src/worldgen/tools/test_goals.gd:190-200 (AUTOMATED_TESTED: Edda at 21:00 completes, Hob does not, noon does not; not run in this audit)
story.notes: needs_code:true is stale. Draft says 'with Edda or Hob' and 'sit by the fire and listen': only Edda counts, opening any conversation counts, no fire or sitting check. Reward {coin_copper 3, rep 1}: 'rep' is ignored by _goals_check (src/stream/server_items.gd:15766-15775).

night_walk.completion_condition: goal_counts['moved_lit_night'] >= 100 metres, added once per slow tick while the game hour is >= 19 or < 6 and the player has a lit 'torch' item in the pack or is within 4 m of a lit fire (steps of 0 or > 30 m ignored); after: [torch_night].
night_walk.notes: needs_code:true is stale. 'without stumbling' is not checked; the torch need only be in the pack (items.json torch flame:true; torch_doused is a different id so a doused torch does not count).

activity:chop_log_blocks.completion_condition: PROPOSED: goal_counts['event:log_chopped'] >= 1, emitted in _chop_loose_log's axe branch after the blocks drop (src/stream/server_items.gd:9266-9277): _goal_event(peer, 'log_chopped', block item id).
evidence: src/stream/server_items.gd:6423-6440 ACT_PROCESS -> _process_trunk -> _chop_loose_log for a loose 'log' or shoulder log
src/stream/server_items.gd:9206-9210 block item by wood class (wood_species.json class_items)
activity:chop_log_blocks.notes: Actual mechanics: a loose log ('log' or a shoulder species log) lying within reach, struck with an axe (ACT_PROCESS), is removed and drops 3 wooden blocks (or 3 large blocks from a shoulder log) on the ground, NOT into the pack; struck with a pick it becomes kindling after 1/speed blows (no blocks). CONTROLS.md:72 says 4 and 12 blocks: stale vs data (3/3). No event today; the blocks are picked up later via _pickup, so an inventory check would also accept blocks from any other source.

activity:place_campfire.completion_condition: goal_counts['event:placed:campfire'] >= 1 (fired when a campfire_kit is placed as a laid fire).
activity:place_campfire.notes: Picking the fire up (hold E, src/stream/server_items.gd:4582-4610) returns the kit; placing it again counts again (pays once). Draft line 41 matches.

activity:place_chopping_block.completion_condition: goal_counts['event:placed:chopping_block'] >= 1 (the chopping_block item is its own kit; placed through _place -> _place_structure -> _after_built).
activity:place_chopping_block.notes: Matches draft line 44 (placed block, not the crafted item). Pick up and re-place counts again (harmless).

activity:medium_fire.completion_condition: PROPOSED: goal_counts['event:fire_tier:2'] >= 1, emitted for the acting peer whenever a LIT fire's state becomes 1 (firewood tier) or 41 (log tier, if 'at least medium' is intended), from one helper that every state change goes through.
evidence: data/items/cooking.json min_pieces = 3, fire_tiers.firewood.state 1, fire_tiers.log.state 41, fuel_class (firewood, firewood_soft, all wooden_block kinds and charcoal are class 'firewood')

src/stream/server_items.gd:7345-7365 _fire_best_state: biggest class with >= min_pieces pieces; pot caps log at firewood (src/stream/server_items.gd:7354-7355); damp wood lowers one tier (src/stream/server_items.gd:7361-7362)
src/stream/server_items.gd:9790-9822 lit fire: tier recomputed when the fire store window closes (ACT_CHEST_CLOSE src/stream/server_items.gd:1148-1149)
src/stream/server_items.gd:9965-9968 unlit fire: store changes sync at once
src/stream/server_items.gd:7614 lighting sets the tier directly
src/stream/server_items.gd:4123-4128 damp->dry tier change in the fire tick (no peer)
activity:medium_fire.notes: Draft claim '3 firewood pieces give medium' is CODE_VERIFIED (min_pieces 3 of class firewood), but any 3 firewood-class pieces count (wooden blocks, charcoal too). If the fire is laid with 3 firewood before lighting, it lights straight into medium and only fire_lit happens. Tier transitions without an acting peer (drying, pot removed) need attribution (record the last peer who fed/lit the fire on the fire row). Wet wood: the fire sits one tier lower while fire['damp'] > 0 and steps up when dry (src/stream/server_items.gd:4123-4128), so the claim 'wet wood delays it' is correct. src/worldgen/tools/test_fire_fuel_tiers.gd exercises tiers (not goals).

activity:bonfire.completion_condition: PROPOSED: goal_counts['event:fire_tier:3'] >= 1 when a lit fire's state becomes 41 (FIRE_STATE_BONFIRE), same helper as medium_fire.
evidence: src/stream/server_items.gd:7520-7535 _fuel refuses logs while a pot hangs
src/stream/server_items.gd:8374-8379 a pot cannot be placed on a fire holding logs
src/stream/server_items.gd:7406-7443 a pot arriving steps a bonfire down
activity:bonfire.notes: Draft claims verified: 3 log-class pieces (any 'log' or log_<species>) make the large fire; a hanging pot caps it at the firewood tier; damp lowers a tier. Note a shoulder (species) log is a pack item since 1 Nov 2026 and can go into the store.

fire_controls.ignite: E on a laid (state 9) or warm-ash fire: client src/client/inventory_view.gd:855-860 sends ACT_LIGHT; server src/stream/server_items.gd:1134-1139 -> _light src/stream/server_items.gd:7568-7618. No starter needed (Dave 5 Nov 2026, src/stream/server_items.gd:7565-7566); warm ash + a tinder item (cooking.json tinder plant_fibre, tinder_also) lights at once (src/stream/server_items.gd:7581-7588). Drizzle makes it a chance roll; heavy rain lights it with a short grace before going out. fire_lit fires only when the fire was laid/ash before and is lit after.
fire_controls.add_fuel: F = key binding 'open' (src/client/key_bindings.gd:29) opens the fire's store; wood put in an unlit fire counts at once (src/stream/server_items.gd:9965-9968), in a lit fire when the window closes (src/stream/server_items.gd:1148-1149 -> src/stream/server_items.gd:9790-9822). ACT_FUEL (one piece, biggest wood first per cooking.json fuel_order) exists on the server (src/stream/server_items.gd:7517-7562) but no client code sends it; only tests do.
fire_controls.put_out: E on a burning fire -> ACT_USE_STRUCT -> _put_out_fire (src/stream/server_items.gd:4563-4577): back to laid (state 9); E again relights and fire_lit counts again.

persistence.storage: goals_done, goal_counts, hints_seen and coins are fields of the character row _characters[key] (src/stream/server_items.gd:18322-18345), written together to characters.json by _save_characters (src/stream/server_items.gd:18178-18179) with tmp+rename (src/stream/server_items.gd:5221-5260).
persistence.coins_file: data/items/coins.json is the coin ladder config only; the purse is _characters[key]['coins'] (src/stream/server_items.gd:11207-11208, src/stream/server_items.gd:11228-11239).
persistence.when_saved: save() every SAVE_EVERY_S = 30 s when _dirty (src/stream/server_items.gd:50, src/stream/server_items.gd:1425-1435), serialised on the tick and written by a background thread in file order inventories.json ... characters.json ... world_items.json (src/stream/server_items.gd:1490, src/stream/server_items.gd:1542-1550). Clean shutdown saves synchronously (scenes/terrain_server/terrain_server.gd:2931-2943). Disconnect does not save; the row stays in memory and goes out with the next autosave (src/stream/server_items.gd:652-700).
persistence.crash_between_award_and_save: coins and goals_done are in the same row of the same file, so both revert together (no double pay, no unpaid done goal); the counters revert too, so the player must redo up to ~30 s of actions. Item rewards land in inventories.json, written before characters.json: a crash between those two renames keeps the item and loses goals_done, so the reward can be paid again when the goal re-completes.
persistence.per_character: The store key is the character's secret key; identity is 'local:<key>' (src/stream/identity_provider.gd:1-24), so per-account and per-character are the same today. A new character (new key, or after forget_key src/stream/server_items.gd:593-604) starts with no goals. Death (src/stream/server_items.gd:12781-12850) keeps goals_done and goal_counts but moves the whole purse, goal coins included, into the remains; real_death is off and the heir flow is not built (data/items/death.json real_death false, novice_grace note).

performance.slow_tick: SLOW_TICK_S = 0.25 s (src/stream/server_items.gd:376): _goals_tick -> _goals_check(peer) for every connected peer 4 times a second (src/stream/server_items.gd:1373-1395, src/stream/server_items.gd:15792-15822); hints every 4th tick.
performance.per_check: _goals_check loops all goals; per not-done goal: goals_done.has, _goal_open (after list), _goal_met (up to 4 str(check.get('event')) allocations, inventory_of lookup, string concatenation for counter keys, inv.count_of slot scan for have_item). The outer while loop rescans everything after any completion, and each completion scans all goals again for the 'Next' line.
performance.event_cost: Every _goal_event/_goal_made/note_talked also runs a full _goals_check synchronously (src/stream/server_items.gd:15676, src/stream/server_items.gd:15688, src/stream/server_items.gd:15223), e.g. each path patch, each drink, each placement, each craft.
performance.estimate_note: ESTIMATE, not measured: GDScript ~3 to 8 microseconds per not-done goal check (have_item with a 20 to 60 slot scan at the upper end).

estimates.651 goals, 1 player: ~2-5 ms per check; 8-20 ms of CPU per second
estimates.651 goals, 32 players: ~65-170 ms per slow tick (SLOW_TICK_LOG_MS is 100 ms, src/stream/server_items.gd:68)
estimates.completion burst (k goals complete in on: (k+1) full scans + k 'Next' scans; a migration that completes 100 goals for one character on first check ~ 100 x 651 x 2 checks = ~0.2-0.6 s stall
